versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the minimalist-entrepreneur skill, inspired by "The Minimalist Entrepreneur" by Sahil Lavingia.
- Provides 10 actionable business skills covering the full startup journey: from finding a community and validating ideas, to building MVPs, pricing, marketing, and sustainable growth.
- Each skill offers clear frameworks, evaluation criteria, anti-patterns to avoid, and step-by-step guidance.
- Designed to help users start and grow businesses with a community-first, minimalist philosophy.
- Includes attribution and links to the original book and source material.
